section.title: Speed limits
section.body: Section 21-801. Speed limits. (a) General rule. - An individual may not drive a vehicle on a highway at a speed that, with regard to the actual and potential dangers existing, is more than that which is reasonable and prudent under the conditions. (b) Maximum limits. - Except as otherwise provided in this section, each maximum speed limit specified in this subtitle or established under this subtitle is a maximum lawful speed.
